description: This file defines the interface ICompositionBuffer and related nested structures for handling composition buffers in a graphics or display system, including plane attributes, iterator functionality, and buffer properties within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: Interface for a composition buffer with methods for managing planes, buffer properties, and rendering operations.

classes.name: IPlane
classes.description: Nested within ICompositionBuffer, represents a plane in the buffer with accessors for buffer ID, stride, and offset.

classes.name: IIterator
classes.description: Nested within ICompositionBuffer, provides iteration over planes with methods to validate, reset, and access the current plane.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increases the reference count for the buffer.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count for the buffer.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the buffer's planes.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Indicates that the buffer has been processed and is done.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for display scanout.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format layout of the buffer.

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the modifier describing the pixel arrangement for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (Invalid, DMA, Raw).
